fullContent:
Prameha Chandrakala Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Prameha Chandrakala Rasa is an ayurvedic tablet which is useful for treatment of diabetes. This herbal medicine helps diabetic patients in controlling the complications like nephropathy, neuropathy, and retinopathy. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Honey 
 Ela 
 Karpoora 
 Dhatri 
 Jatiphala 
 Sutendra 
 Vanga 
 Ayasa 
 Guduchi 
 Shalmali 
 Honey 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are mixed to honey and tablets are prepared. 
 Dose 
 Consume 1-2 tablets daily before or after having meals or as directed by doctor. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is useful in Diabetes. 
 It can manage complication of Diabetes like nephropathy, neuropathy, and retinopathy. 
 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 
 Its self-medication might be dangerous. 
 It’s over dose may result in tremors or dizziness. 
 Avoid its use in conceiving women or infants. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
